questions.prompt: Will you accept the off-site transformer manufacturing as the start of construction in December 2025?
questions.context: On-site physical work began January 12, 2026, and the notice to proceed is not physical work. The seller relies on custom transformer manufacture beginning December 22, 2025 under a binding contract dated December 10, 2025. Only the manufacturer's letter supports this; the contract itself and production records have not been provided, and the independent engineer gives no opinion. The answer decides two other assumptions. Domestic content qualifies at 47.8% only under the 45% threshold for a 2025 start. The foreign-entity material assistance rules apply only to a 2026 start, and failing them means no credit.

evidence.text: On-site physical work of a significant nature, beginning with pile installation for the tracker foundations, commenced on January 12, 2026.
We have not reviewed the manufacturer's records and express no opinion on the tax treatment of off-site work.
Physical manufacture of the transformer, beginning with cutting and stacking of the custom core, commenced at our facility on December 22, 2025 and continued thereafter.
If construction is determined to have begun in 2026, the applicable threshold would be 50% and the Project would not qualify at the computed adjusted percentage.

options.label: Accept a December 22, 2025 start once the contract and production records are delivered
options.consequence: Domestic content qualifies at 47.8% against the 45% threshold, and the material assistance rules do not apply. The 50% credit rate holds on the bonus side, subject to the apprenticeship issue.

options.label: Treat construction as beginning January 12, 2026 (on-site work)
options.consequence: Domestic content fails the 50% threshold, so the 10% bonus is lost and the rate falls to 40%. The material assistance rules apply, and the credit is at risk entirely until the module certification and cost ratio show compliance.

options.label: Defer the decision until the substantiating documents are reviewed
options.consequence: The construction start, domestic content and material assistance outcomes stay open. Make substantiation a condition precedent to signing.
